breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified and removed the erroneous instruction to use the bending second moment I (I = π d^4/64) for torsion relations. The generated specification only includes the correct formula for the polar moment of area, J = π d^4/32, which aligns with the ground truth prompt.
